title: Emergent Metric Structure Candidate
purpose: Define the governed conditions under which metric-like structure may emerge from the continuous mismatch field candidate MF_Δ without importing scalar metrics, coordinates, topology, units, or physical measurement assumptions.
summary: This patch introduces a provisional emergent metric structure candidate downstream of MF_Δ. It does not define a completed metric. It identifies the minimal governance conditions required before repeated qualitative Δ evaluations may support metric-like comparison, ordering stability, boundary-relative structure, and transition coherence.

basis.scope: Provisional metric-structure candidate witness that extends MF_Δ into a governed comparison layer while leaving RT_core unchanged and keeping quantitative metric construction deferred.

core_rule.statement: EMS_Δ may be introduced only downstream of an admitted MF_Δ field candidate, and only as a provisional metric-like structure candidate that remains distinct from a completed metric, metric space, topology, manifold, or physical measurement rule.

EmergentMetricStructureCandidate.definition: A provisional metric-like structure candidate inferred from governed patterns in MF_Δ when repeated Δ evaluations preserve ordinal coherence, transition traceability, admissibility-boundary behavior, and context identity.
EmergentMetricStructureCandidate.canonical_form: EMS_Δ := MetricStructureCandidate(MF_Δ | OrdCoh(MF_Δ) ∧ TransTrace(MF_Δ) ∧ BoundCoh(MF_Δ) ∧ CtxPres(MF_Δ))

OrdinalCoherence.definition: The condition that repeated ordinal mismatch classifications preserve governed ordering without requiring scalar spacing or numerical magnitude.

TransitionTraceability.definition: The condition that ordinal transitions within MF_Δ remain traceable to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055 transition discipline.

BoundaryCoherence.definition: The condition that admissibility-boundary approach, contact, crossing, retreat, persistence, and break behavior remain traceable to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056.

ContextPreservation.definition: The condition that each Δ evaluation remains bound to its declared evaluation context Ctx_Δ and that comparisons across evaluations do not erase domain, scale, symmetry-reference, or residue-asymmetry information.

formal_reading.field_candidate: MF_Δ := FieldCandidate({ Δ_i(A_i <S_i>_{r_a,i} E_i) } | Ctx_Δ declared for each i)
formal_reading.metric_structure_candidate: EMS_Δ := MetricStructureCandidate(MF_Δ | OrdCoh(MF_Δ) ∧ TransTrace(MF_Δ) ∧ BoundCoh(MF_Δ) ∧ CtxPres(MF_Δ))
formal_reading.important_limit: EMS_Δ is metric-like structure, not a scalar metric, metric space, topology, manifold, or physical measurement rule.

admissibility_conditions: MF_Δ must already be admitted under PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_057.
Every Δ evaluation must retain declared Ctx_Δ.
Ordinal mismatch classifications must remain governed by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_054.
Ordinal transitions must remain governed by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055.
Admissibility-boundary behavior must remain governed by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056.
Repeated evaluations must preserve enough trace structure to compare ordinal behavior without erasing context.
Metric-like structure may be inferred only from governed patterns, not imported from external metric assumptions.

governance_rules.rule: EMS_Δ may be introduced only downstream of an admitted MF_Δ field candidate.
EMS_Δ does not assign scalar values to ordinal mismatch classes.
EMS_Δ does not imply equal spacing between ordinal classes.
EMS_Δ does not introduce coordinates, topology, continuity, differentiability, units, or physical measurement.
EMS_Δ may compare governed ordinal structure only when CtxPres(MF_Δ) holds.
If ordinal transitions cannot be traced to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055, EMS_Δ admission fails.
If boundary behavior cannot be traced to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056, EMS_Δ admission fails.
If MF_Δ is treated as a scalar, vector, topological, or physical field, EMS_Δ admission fails.

failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_NO_FIELD: EMS_Δ is attempted without admitted MF_Δ.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_CONTEXT_ERASURE: Evaluation contexts are erased or conflated during comparison.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_NUMERIC_IMPORT: Scalar values, equal spacing, units, or numerical magnitudes are assigned without governance.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_TOPOLOGY_IMPORT: Topological, manifold, coordinate, continuity, or differentiability assumptions are introduced prematurely.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_TRANSITION_BREAK: Ordinal transitions are not traceable to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_BOUNDARY_BREAK: Boundary behavior is not traceable to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056.
failure_modes.FAIL_EMS_DELTA_COLLAPSE: Δ is collapsed into distance, norm, or physical metric.

forbidden_inferences: EMS_Δ is not a completed metric.
EMS_Δ is not a metric space.
EMS_Δ is not a scalar metric.
EMS_Δ is not a physical measurement rule.
EMS_Δ does not make ordinal classes numeric.
EMS_Δ does not imply equal spacing.
EMS_Δ does not promote projection to theorem.

textbook_integration.integration_note: Present EMS_Δ as a governed candidate for metric-like structure emerging from MF_Δ, not as a completed metric or quantitative calculus.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the metric-structure candidate witness that introduces EMS_Δ as a provisional structure inferred from MF_Δ.
Add the trace schema that records context-typed repeated Delta evaluations and ordinal comparison stability.
Add the counterexample that blocks numeric, topological, and physical-field readings of EMS_Δ.
Register the new documentation surfaces by hash for governance visibility.
Add the proposed-registration ledger record for the 058 execution-surface update.
